# Anthony Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Brierley School  <sub>[v2 c5 P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony has a small, dark face and black eyes that glare with enmity.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)_

## Personality

Anthony is a sullen, defiant, and rebellious boy who resists authority and gentle lectures on proper behavior. He harbors strong enmities, but he earns respect through physical strength and toughness rather than gentleness. Despite his stubborn nature, he can be won over when his standard of firmness is met, showing respect and even fellowship afterward.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c12 P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_

## Traits

- Sullen and dark-tempered  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)</sub>
- Defiant toward authority  <sub>[v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033)</sub>
- Respects physical discipline over gentle persuasion  <sub>[v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052), [v2 c12 P53](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0053), [v2 c12 P54](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0054)</sub>

## History

Anthony attended Brierley School under the instruction of Nell Harcourt. On her first day, he sat alone in a corner desk glaring at her with black, inimical eyes. During class, he committed a disciplinary offense by emptying the last drops of water from his slate bottle down Aurelia Clay's neck, for which Nell kept him inside during recess to lecture him on how gentlemen should behave. Unmoved by her words, Anthony let out a contemptuous whistle as he departed.

Later in the term, Anthony engaged in misbehavior that pushed Nell to lose her temper and hit him across the palms with a wooden pointer until he cried and surrendered his defiance. Although Nell worried she had permanently alienated him, the physical punishment unexpectedly gained Anthony's respect. The next morning, as Nell walked to school through deep snow, Anthony trudged past, raised his cap to her for the first time, and offered to carry her schoolbooks. He subsequently remarked to others that Nell was worth something despite being a girl, approvingly noting that the beating she had delivered was as good as a man's.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c12 P32](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0032), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c12 P48](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0048), [v2 c12 P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_
